page.overview:
Who is Audrii IV?

Emperor Audrii IV was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 2666–2675 AG), succeeding his father Halleck IV.

Audrii was the last emperor of the House of Halleck Corrino. He was succeeded by three co-ruling regents, who established the Triumvirate.
